findings.title: Test cleanup removes wrong alias, leaking IDPs
findings.body: In testCacheIDPByOrg and testCacheIDPForLogin the test creates IDPs in a loop with variable alias (e.g. "org-idp-"+i / "idp-alias-"+i) but registers cleanup as testRealm().identityProviders().get("alias")::remove with the literal string "alias". That cleanup tries to delete a non-existent IDP named "alias" and never deletes the 10-20 IDPs actually created. The same wrong literal is repeated at lines 381 and 425. Consequence: created brokers leak into the test realm, pollute counts for later assertions on cached login/org queries, and make the suite order-dependent and flaky.

findings.title: update/remove dereferences null IDP model causing NPE
findings.body: update() does IdentityProviderModel idpById = getById(model.getInternalId()) which returns null when the id is null or not found, then unconditionally calls registerIDPInvalidation(idpById) which calls idp.getInternalId() and idp.getAlias(). remove() has the same pattern with storedIdp = idpDelegate.getByAlias(alias) followed by registerIDPInvalidation(storedIdp) when the alias key is invalidated. If the alias/id does not exist, storedIdp/idpById is null and the call throws NullPointerException. Consequence: updating or removing a missing broker fails with a 500 NPE instead of returning false / proper not-found handling.

findings.title: getForLogin ignores organization invalidations and serves stale brokers
findings.body: getByOrganization bypasses cache when isInvalid(cacheKey) || isInvalid(orgId), but the new getForLogin only checks if (isInvalid(cacheKey)). getForLogin results depend on organization state: which orgs exist/are enabled and which IDPs are linked to a given orgId (searchKey is organizationId). When an organization is updated, disabled, or removed its orgId is invalidated but the login query objects keyed by realm+FetchMode are not considered invalid. Subsequent getForLogin calls therefore hit the stale IdentityProviderListQuery and return ID sets containing brokers from disabled/removed orgs or missing newly linked/unlinked brokers. The added isEnabled re-check in OrganizationAwareIdentityProviderBean only patches two UI branches, not the provider contract, so direct callers of getForLogin get stale login options.
